recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes the only discovered current-source inconsistency for FHIR-43499 and leaves the separate FHIR-45508 reconciliation intact.
issue_request: FHIR-43499 was Applied with Persuasive with Modification resolution for R6. It requested correction of the unclear Group.characteristic.determinedBy[x] definition; the final resolution split the choice into Group.characteristic.formula and Group.characteristic.determiner, with determiner referencing Practitioner, PractitionerRole, Organization, Device, or DeviceDefinition.
initial_application: The current StructureDefinition already contains the resolved formula and determiner elements. Prior history removed DeviceMetric from the determiner target profiles and added the FHIR-43499 determiner comment, but a later Group notes move copied stale narrative text that still allowed DeviceMetric and described formula/determiner as modifying Group.characteristic.code.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini shows Group and the formula/determiner elements are active build inputs. The FHIR-I Zulip thread asked for Group notes explaining the characteristic elements and recorded the split into formula and determiner. FHIR-I minutes show the DeviceMetric question was sent to OO on 2025-06-09 and that OO agreed to remove DeviceMetric before FHIR-I approved FHIR-43499 on 2025-06-16.
reconciliation: Changed source/group/group-notes.xml to describe formula as the expression used to generate the characteristic value and determiner as the entity expected to evaluate the characteristic value. The determiner narrative now lists only Practitioner, PractitionerRole, Organization, Device, and DeviceDefinition, matching the StructureDefinition.
source_changes: source/group/group-notes.xml: updated two Group.characteristic formula/determiner paragraphs to align with the resolved StructureDefinition and remove DeviceMetric.

related_jiras.note: The same Zulip thread said the Group notes work should cover FHIR-45508 too; that separate relativeTime/duration wording issue already has a combined-branch reconciliation commit.
